study.Elite QB, weak D: Our rebuild of the rule (career QB EPA top 20%, own D success allowed worst 20%): 2006–20 397 games won 68.5% at 61¢; 2021–26 162 games won 68.5% at 58.5¢. The research write-up's version (150 games, 71% at 59¢) used a slightly different cut. Edge used: +6¢ (shrunk).
study.Key WR out: Team missing a key WR (70%+ snaps): priced about 4¢ too high in 2013–20 and 2021–26 (309 / 248 games). Tracked on the other side.
study.Underdog experts pick: Underdog picks by our 3 best underdog experts: 50 of 112 won, +6% a pick over 2025–26. Small sample.
study.Hot streak overpriced: Teams on a hot player streak were priced 4–9¢ too high (QB 3+ straight 250-yd games, RB1 or WR1 2+ straight 100-yd games). Betting the other side: +1 to +5¢, small. Tracked on the other side.
